name: get_default_policy
title: Get Default Policy

description: Compare a report with its baseline, as the PR comment does: regressions, improvements and broken budgets. Read the top-level `verdict` first.

ResourceSelect.description:
One resource of a `Select`: the entities to read, each with every
section and value the report has of it.

keys.description:
Exact, case-sensitive entity keys. Their format depends on the
resource and is given by its field of `Select`; mostly a diff row's
`key`, but io takes the value's label and keeps every operation of it.

Select.description:
`select=` as sent: per resource, exact entity keys.
Shared by the REST query and the MCP tools, whose schema it is.

http.description: HTTP call keys: `name | route | source`, `-` for a part the entry lacks.

sql.description: SQL keys: `query | route | source`, `-` for a part the entry lacks.

threads.description:
Thread keys: the thread name; keeps every thread of that name in a
payload and the diff's row summing them.

benchmark.description: The benchmark name, as `list_benchmarks` prints it.

commit.description:
Full 40-character commit sha: the newest report measuring it or headed
at it is the head.

event.description: Narrows `pr` / `commit` to one event; not with `id`.

id.description: A report id as the head.

pr.description:
Pull request number: the PR's newest report is the head. One of `pr`,
`commit`, `id`.

precise.description:
`true`: values, changes and budget figures unrounded, durations in
`ns`, sizes in `B`. Default `false`: rounded for reading.

repo.description: The repository as `owner/name`, as `list_repos` prints it.

rows.description:
`findings` (default without `select`): the rows the PR comment lists.
`advisory`: plus the findings of unjudged families. `all` (default
with `select`): every row, cell and total.

select.description:
Keep only the rows and omissions of these entities, as in get_report:
per resource exact `keys`; an io label keeps every op row of it. A
section left without any is dropped. Combines with `rows`.

name: get_diff
title: Compare Report With Baseline

description: Fetch one report: its summary, verdict and policy, optionally with its hotpath JSON payload. not_found means CI has not uploaded it yet. For what changed against the baseline, use get_diff.

threads.description:

benchmark.description: The benchmark name, as `list_benchmarks` prints it.

at it (a PR branch's `git rev-parse HEAD` finds the PR's report).

event.description: Narrows `pr` / `commit` to one event; not with `id`.

include_payload.description:
Include the uploaded hotpath JSON report. Default: false without
`select`, true with it; `false` with `select` is refused.

pr.description: Pull request number: the PR's newest report. One of `pr`, `commit`, `id`.

precise.description:
`true`: measurements unrounded, durations in `ns`, sizes in `B`
(payload values as uploaded). Default `false`: rounded for reading.

repo.description: The repository as `owner/name`, as `list_repos` prints it.

select.description:
Keep only these entities in the payload, per resource
(`functions`, `sql`, `http`, `server`, `mutexes`, `rw_locks`, `channels`,
`io`, `threads`) exact, case-sensitive `keys` (function name; sql and
http `name | route | source` with `-` for a missing part; io the
value's label, every op of it; server the route; locks and channels
the label; threads the thread name, every thread of it). Up to 20 keys.

name: get_report
title: Get Report

description: List a repository's reports, newest first, as summaries with their run totals. Use it to browse report history; with `select`, to follow given entities across runs.

ResourceSelect.description:
One resource of a `Select`: the entities to read, each with every
section and value the report has of it.

keys.description:
Exact, case-sensitive entity keys. Their format depends on the
resource and is given by its field of `Select`; mostly a diff row's
`key`, but io takes the value's label and keeps every operation of it.

Select.description:

Shared by the REST query and the MCP tools, whose schema it is.

http.description: HTTP call keys: `name | route | source`, `-` for a part the entry lacks.

sql.description: SQL keys: `query | route | source`, `-` for a part the entry lacks.

threads.description:
Thread keys: the thread name; keeps every thread of that name in a
payload and the diff's row summing them.

benchmark.description:
Only this benchmark's reports, by name as `list_benchmarks` prints it.
Default: every benchmark of the repository.

branch.description:
Bare branch name (`main`): reports that measured that branch's ref,
in practice its push reports; pair with `event: push` for the
baseline series. For a PR's own reports use `pr`.

commit.description: Full 40-character commit sha: reports measuring it or headed at it.

cursor.description: `next_cursor` of the previous page, with the same filters.

limit.description:
Reports per page, 1 to 50, default 20; with `select` 1 to 20,
default 10.

metadata.description:
Only reports whose user_metadata has all of these keys with exactly
these values (e.g. {"runner": "Linux-ARM64"}); up to 8 pairs. Reports
without metadata never match.

repo.description: The repository as `owner/name`, as `list_repos` prints it.

select.description: Return each report with its payload, filtered as get_report's `select`.

since.description: Uploaded at or after this time: RFC 3339, or `YYYY-MM-DD` (UTC midnight).

until.description: Uploaded before this time, same format as `since`.
